recognize_zh: 在厚重紅血球背景中，一條黏著成片的大細胞群，核圓、染色質細緻並有核仁，細胞質淡藍帶空泡，其中可見疑似核分裂像；右下一顆大細胞有多個核仁，屬於骨髓中的轉移性癌細胞團。
features: Cohesive band-like cluster of large cells with shared pale blue cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli; some nuclear overlap
Vacuolated cytoplasm at the cluster edges
Probable mitotic figure within the cluster and a large cell at lower right with multiple nucleoli
Thick red cell background with rare platelets
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive, band-like cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells set in a thick red cell background. The cells have round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and visible nucleoli, moderate pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm and focal nuclear overlap; a probable mitotic figure is present, and a large cell at lower right shows multiple nucleoli. Normal hematopoietic cells are not evident within the cluster. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma in the bone marrow, compatible with the known breast primary.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are loosely arranged with eccentric nuclei and a hof separate from the nucleus, lacking nuclear overlap, mitoses and prominent nucleoli.
Erythroid islands center on a macrophage with surrounding erythroblasts showing deeply basophilic cytoplasm and progressive maturation, not uniform vacuolated epithelial cells.
Lymphoma cells are discohesive and CD45/CD20 positive, whereas carcinoma forms true cohesive groups that are cytokeratin positive.
